## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, format, typecheck, tests)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change (parser changes include a sample that motivated them)
- [ ] Updated `README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` if public behavior or the API changed
- [ ] Change stays within the project's scope (aggregate/RUA report parsing, dependency-light)
